phase: Phase 7: Cellular Fallback & Cloud Relay Bridge

stories.title: Ktor WebSocket Cloud Mesh Relay Gateway
stories.description: Implement CloudRelayBridge in commonMain to seamlessly connect the local BLE mesh to the Ktor server (:server) via WebSockets, allowing audio and control frames to bridge across cellular data when riders are out of direct BLE range.
acceptanceCriteria: CloudRelayBridge serializes and transmits encrypted MeshPacket instances over WebSocket
Receives remote mesh packets from server and injects them into local mesh deduplication pipeline
Handles connection drops, reconnect backoff, and dual-transport state transitions

stories.title: Low-Power BLE Proximity Radar & Distance UI
stories.description: Create a proximity radar model and cockpit visualization displaying relative distances and RF link margins to all riders in the mesh group.
acceptanceCriteria: ProximityRadar maps RSSI and path loss into discrete proximity zones (NEAR, MEDIUM, FAR, OUT_OF_RANGE)
Generates reactive flow of proximity updates for Compose and SwiftUI views

stories.title: Dynamic Mesh Topology Auto-Healing & Leader Re-Election
stories.description: Implement auto-healing leadership election in GroupManager when the active group leader disconnects or is out of range.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects leader heartbeat timeout within 15 seconds
Executes deterministic Bully election or highest-link-margin consensus
Elects new coordinator without severing audio session

stories.title: GitHub Actions Multiplatform CI/CD Pipeline
stories.description: Configure GitHub Actions CI/CD matrix to automate multiplatform test execution, release APK building, and iOS compilation checks on every PR and release tag.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow runs ./gradlew test across all modules
Builds Android assembleRelease and verifies ProGuard/R8 rules
